import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import json
import time
import re

headers = {
    'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36',
    'Accept': 'text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.8',
    'Accept-Language': 'zh-CN,zh;q=0.9,en;q=0.8'
}

def search_bing(query):
    """Search Bing and return results"""
    url = f"https://www.bing.com/search?q={requests.utils.quote(query)}"
    try:
        resp = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=15)
        soup = BeautifulSoup(resp.text, 'lxml')
        results = []
        for li in soup.find_all('li', class_='b_algo'):
            title_el = li.find('h2')
            snippet_el = li.find('div', class_='b_caption')
            if title_el:
                title = title_el.get_text()
                link = title_el.find('a')['href'] if title_el.find('a') else ''
                snippet = snippet_el.get_text() if snippet_el else ''
                results.append({'title': title, 'link': link, 'snippet': snippet})
        return results
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Bing search error: {e}")
        return []

# Search queries
queries = [
    '一带一路 中企海外项目 2025年 竣工 投运',
    '一带一路 海外工程 2025年1月 2月 3月 4月 5月 竣工',
    '中国企业 海外项目 2025年 完工 一带一路',
    '中国承包 海外工程 2025年 竣工投运',
    '一带一路项目 2025年 竣工 通车 投运',
    '中企承建 海外 2025年 竣工 交付',
]

all_results = []
for q in queries:
    print(f"Searching: {q}")
    results = search_bing(q)
    for r in results:
        print(f"  - {r['title']}")
        print(f"    {r['link']}")
        print(f"    {r['snippet'][:200]}")
    all_results.extend(results)
    time.sleep(2)

print(f"\nTotal results found: {len(all_results)}")

# Save links for further scraping
links = [r['link'] for r in all_results]
with open('/workspace/links.json', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump(all_results, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

print("Results saved to links.json")
PYEOF

import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import time
import json

headers = {
    'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36',
}

def search_ddg(query):
    """Search DuckDuckGo HTML version"""
    url = f"https://html.duckduckgo.com/html/?q={requests.utils.quote(query)}"
    try:
        resp = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=15)
        soup = BeautifulSoup(resp.text, 'lxml')
        results = []
        for a in soup.find_all('a', class_='result__a'):
            title = a.get_text()
            link = a.get('href', '')
            snippet_el = a.find_next('a', class_='result__snippet')
            snippet = snippet_el.get_text() if snippet_el else ''
            results.append({'title': title, 'link': link, 'snippet': snippet})
        return results
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"DDG error: {e}")
        return []

def search_bing(query):
    """Search Bing with better parsing"""
    url = f"https://www.bing.com/search?q={requests.utils.quote(query)}&count=20"
    try:
        resp = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=15)
        soup = BeautifulSoup(resp.text, 'lxml')
        results = []
        # Try multiple selectors
        for li in soup.find_all('li', class_='b_algo'):
            h2 = li.find('h2')
            if h2:
                a = h2.find('a')
                title = h2.get_text()
                link = a.get('href', '') if a else ''
                caption = li.find('div', class_='b_caption')
                snippet = caption.get_text() if caption else ''
                results.append({'title': title, 'link': link, 'snippet': snippet})
        if not results:
            print(f"  Bing HTML structure different, saving page for debug")
            with open('/tmp/bing_debug.html', 'w') as f:
                f.write(resp.text[:5000])
        return results
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Bing error: {e}")
        return []

def search_baidu(query):
    """Search Baidu"""
    url = f"https://www.baidu.com/s?wd={requests.utils.quote(query)}&rn=20"
    try:
        resp = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=15)
        soup = BeautifulSoup(resp.text, 'lxml')
        results = []
        for div in soup.find_all('div', class_='result'):
            h3 = div.find('h3')
            if h3:
                a = h3.find('a')
                title = h3.get_text()
                link = a.get('href', '') if a else ''
                content = div.find('div', class_='c-abstract') or div.find('span', class_='content-right_8Zs40')
                snippet = content.get_text() if content else ''
                results.append({'title': title, 'link': link, 'snippet': snippet})
        return results
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Baidu error: {e}")
        return []

queries = [
    '一带一路 中企海外项目 2025年 竣工 投运',
    '一带一路 海外工程 2025年 竣工',
    '中国企业 海外项目 2025年 完工 一带一路',
    '中国承包 海外工程 2025年 竣工投运',
    '一带一路项目 2025年 竣工 通车 投运',
    '中企承建 海外 2025年 竣工 交付',
    '中国承建 海外项目 2025年 竣工',
    '一带一路 2025 竣工 项目',
]

all_results = []
seen_urls = set()

print("=== DuckDuckGo Search ===")
for q in queries:
    print(f"\nSearching DDG: {q}")
    results = search_ddg(q)
    for r in results:
        if r['link'] not in seen_urls:
            seen_urls.add(r['link'])
            all_results.append(r)
            print(f"  - {r['title'][:80]}")
            print(f"    {r['link'][:100]}")
            print(f"    {r['snippet'][:150]}")
    time.sleep(1.5)

print("\n=== Bing Search ===")
for q in queries:
    print(f"\nSearching Bing: {q}")
    results = search_bing(q)
    for r in results:
        if r['link'] not in seen_urls:
            seen_urls.add(r['link'])
            all_results.append(r)
            print(f"  - {r['title'][:80]}")
            print(f"    {r['link'][:100]}")
            print(f"    {r['snippet'][:150]}")
    time.sleep(1.5)

print(f"\n\nTotal unique results: {len(all_results)}")
with open('/workspace/all_results.json', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump(all_results, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
print("Saved to all_results.json")

import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import time
import json
import re

headers = {
    'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36',
}

def fetch_page(url):
    try:
        resp = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=15)
        resp.encoding = resp.apparent_encoding
        return resp.text
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error fetching {url}: {e}")
        return ''

# First, let's search for weekly reports on yidaiyilu.gov.cn
# These weekly reports list completed projects
weekly_urls = []

# Search for weekly project reports
search_queries = [
    'site:yidaiyilu.gov.cn 中企海外项目周报 2025',
    'site:yidaiyilu.gov.cn 竣工 投运 2025',
    'site:chinca.org 竣工 2025',
]

# Let's try to access yidaiyilu.gov.cn weekly reports directly
# The weekly reports seem to follow a pattern
print("=== Searching DDG for weekly reports ===")
for q in search_queries:
    url = f"https://html.duckduckgo.com/html/?q={requests.utils.quote(q)}"
    try:
        resp = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=15)
        soup = BeautifulSoup(resp.text, 'lxml')
        for a in soup.find_all('a', class_='result__a'):
            title = a.get_text()
            link = a.get('href', '')
            print(f"  {title[:100]}")
            print(f"  {link[:150]}")
            snippet_el = a.find_next('a', class_='result__snippet')
            if snippet_el:
                print(f"  {snippet_el.get_text()[:200]}")
            print()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error: {e}")
    time.sleep(1.5)

# Now let's try to access the weekly reports page directly
print("\n=== Accessing yidaiyilu.gov.cn weekly reports ===")
ydyl_url = 'https://www.yidaiyilu.gov.cn/'
try:
    resp = requests.get(ydyl_url, headers=headers, timeout=15)
    resp.encoding = resp.apparent_encoding
    soup = BeautifulSoup(resp.text, 'lxml')
    # Find links to weekly reports
    for a in soup.find_all('a'):
        text = a.get_text()
        href = a.get('href', '')
        if '周报' in text or '竣工' in text or '投运' in text or '2025' in text:
            print(f"  {text[:80]} -> {href[:100]}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error: {e}")

print("\n=== Accessing specific pages ===")
# Try the weekly report pages
weekly_report_urls = [
    'https://www.yidaiyilu.gov.cn/p/0RH1BJLG.html',  # 2025 keywords article
]

for url in weekly_report_urls:
    print(f"\n--- Fetching: {url} ---")
    content = fetch_page(url)
    if content:
        soup = BeautifulSoup(content, 'lxml')
        # Remove scripts and styles
        for s in soup(['script', 'style']):
            s.decompose()
        text = soup.get_text()
        # Print relevant parts
        for line in text.split('\n'):
            line = line.strip()
            if line and any(kw in line for kw in ['竣工', '投运', '完工', '通车', '交付', '启用', '投产', '落成', '2025年']):
                print(f"  {line[:200]}")
    time.sleep(1)
PYEOF

}

def fetch_page(url):

        resp.encoding = resp.apparent_encoding
        return resp.text
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error fetching {url}: {e}")
        return ''

    # Find all links on the page
    links_found = []
    for a in soup.find_all('a'):
        text = a.get_text().strip()
        href = a.get('href', '')
        if text and href:
            links_found.append((text, href))
            if '周报' in text or '2025' in text or '项目' in text:
                print(f"  {text[:80]} -> {href}")
    
    # Also check for pagination
    print(f"\nTotal links found: {len(links_found)}")
    
    # Look for report links
    report_links = []
    for a in soup.find_all('a'):
        href = a.get('href', '')
        text = a.get_text().strip()
        if '/p/' in href and any(kw in text for kw in ['周报', '项目', '2025']):
            if not href.startswith('http'):
                href = 'https://www.yidaiyilu.gov.cn' + href
            report_links.append({'title': text, 'url': href})
            print(f"  Report: {text[:80]} -> {href}")
    
    # Save all links for debugging
    with open('/tmp/weekly_links.json', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        json.dump([{'text': t, 'href': h} for t, h in links_found], f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    
    # Try to find page structure
    print("\n=== Page structure analysis ===")
    # Print main content divs
    for div in soup.find_all(['div', 'ul', 'li'], class_=True):
        cls = div.get('class', [])
        cls_str = ' '.join(cls) if isinstance(cls, list) else str(cls)
        text = div.get_text().strip()[:100]
        if text and len(text) > 5:
            print(f"  [{div.name}.{cls_str}] {text[:100]}")
            if len(text) > 100:
                break
else:
    print("Failed to fetch listing page")

import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import time
import json
import re

headers = {
    'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36',
}

session = requests.Session()
session.headers.update(headers)

# First get main page for cookies
session.get('https://www.yidaiyilu.gov.cn/', timeout=15)
time.sleep(1)

# Use ?page= pagination
print("=== Finding 2025 reports with ?page= pagination ===")
all_2025_reports = []

for page in range(1, 21):
    url = f"https://www.yidaiyilu.gov.cn/list/w/xmzb?page={page}"
    try:
        resp = session.get(url, timeout=15)
        resp.encoding = resp.apparent_encoding
        soup = BeautifulSoup(resp.text, 'lxml')
        
        years_on_page = set()
        found_2025 = []
        
        for a in soup.find_all('a'):
            text = a.get_text().strip()
            href = a.get('href', '')
            if '周报' in text and '/p/' in href:
                ym = re.search(r'(20\d{2})', text)
                if ym:
                    years_on_page.add(ym.group(1))
                if '2025' in text:
                    if not href.startswith('http'):
                        href = 'https://www.yidaiyilu.gov.cn' + href
                    found_2025.append({'title': text, 'url': href})
                    all_2025_reports.append({'title': text, 'url': href})
        
        if found_2025 or years_on_page:
            print(f"Page {page}: years={years_on_page}, 2025 reports={len(found_2025)}")
            for r in found_2025:
                print(f"  {r['title'][:80]} -> {r['url']}")
        else:
            print(f"Page {page}: no reports found")
        
        time.sleep(0.5)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Page {page} error: {e}")

print(f"\nTotal 2025 reports found: {len(all_2025_reports)}")

# Filter Jan-May 2025
jan_may = []
for r in all_2025_reports:
    m = re.search(r'2025\.(\d+)\.(\d+)', r['title'])
    if m:
        month = int(m.group(1))
        if month <= 5:
            jan_may.append(r)
            print(f"  Jan-May: {r['title']}")
    else:
        # Also check for 双周报 format
        m2 = re.search(r'2025\.(\d+)\.(\d+)', r['title'])
        if m2 and int(m2.group(1)) <= 6:
            jan_may.append(r)

print(f"\nJan-May 2025: {len(jan_may)}")
with open('/workspace/2025_reports.json', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump({'all': all_2025_reports, 'jan_may': jan_may}, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

        i += 2
    else:

        i += 1
    
    # Check if this is actually a completed project (not just starting construction)
    completion_keywords = ['竣工', '投运', '完工', '通车', '交付', '启用', '投产', '落成', '移交', '通过验收', '并网', '全容量', '揭牌', '揭幕', '集中移交', '正式开通', '运营']
    start_keywords = ['开工', '启动', '签约', '中标', '奠基', '动工', '开焊', '吊装', '封顶', '贯通', '计划', '预计']
    
    combined = title_line + ' ' + detail_line
    
    # Check if it's a completion event
    has_completion = any(kw in combined for kw in completion_keywords)
    
    # Check if it's primarily a start/planning event
    has_start = any(kw in combined for kw in start_keywords)
    
    # Skip if it's only about starting or planning
    if not has_completion:
        continue
    
    # Skip if it mentions future completion (预计/计划 竣工/完工)
    future_patterns = [r'预计.*\d+年.*完[工成]', r'计划.*\d+年.*完[工成]', r'预计.*\d+年.*竣工', r'计划.*\d+年.*竣工', r'预计.*\d+年.*投[产运]', r'计划.*\d+年.*投[产运]']

    ]
    for p in country_patterns:
        m = re.search(p, combined)
        if m:

    # Also extract country from title
    if title_line:
        # Country is often at the beginning of the title
        title_countries = re.findall(r'([\u4e00-\u9fff]{2,6}?)(?:\d+|[A-Z]|示范|电网|机场|公路|铁路|水电|光伏|风电|油田|体育场|学校|医院|保障房|市政|码头|港口|产业园|工厂|生产线|办公楼|桥梁|隧道|大坝|水库|营地|社区|酒店|公寓)', title_line)
        for tc in title_countries:

    project['countries'] = countries

    contractors = []
    contractor_patterns = [

            if contractor and len(contractor) > 2:

    project['contractors'] = contractors
    
    # Extract start date
    start_date = ''
    start_patterns = [

        r'(\d{4}年\d+月)开工',
        r'(\d{4}年\d+月)正式开工',
        r'(\d{4}年\d+月)开工建设',

        r'于(\d{4}年\d+月)开工',

    project['project_name'] = project_name.strip()
    project['country'] = countries[0] if countries else ''
    project['contractor'] = contractors[0] if contractors else ''
    
    projects.append(project)

import json
import re

with open('/workspace/report_content.json', 'r') as f:
    raw_data = json.load(f)

with open('/workspace/projects_extracted.json', 'r') as f:
    projects = json.load(f)

# Let's rebuild more carefully from raw data
# First, pair up title and detail lines
report_date_map = {}
for item in raw_data:
    report = item['report']
    m = re.search(r'[（(](\d{4})\.(\d+)\.(\d+)-(\d{4})\.(\d+)\.(\d+)[）)]', report)
    if m:
        end_month = int(m.group(5))
        end_year = m.group(4)
        report_date_map[report] = f"{end_year}年{end_month}月"

# Rebuild pairs
pairs = []
i = 0
while i < len(raw_data):
    item = raw_data[i]
    report = item['report']
    line = item['line']
    
    # Check if this is a title line (short, no date prefix, no "近日/日前")
    is_title = (len(line) < 80 and 
                not line.startswith('近日') and 
                not line.startswith('日前') and
                not re.match(r'^\d+月\d+日', line) and
                not re.match(r'^\d{4}年\d+月\d+日', line) and
                not line.startswith('该') and
                not line.startswith('项目') and
                not line.startswith('其') and
                not line.startswith('（') and
                not line.startswith('此') and
                not line.startswith('截至') and
                not line.startswith('梅罗') and
                not line.startswith('Per') and
                not line.startswith('新校园'))
    
    if is_title and i + 1 < len(raw_data) and raw_data[i+1]['report'] == report:
        pairs.append({
            'report': report,
            'title': line,
            'detail': raw_data[i+1]['line'],
            'report_date': report_date_map.get(report, '')
        })
        i += 2
    else:
        # standalone detail
        # Check if it has completion keywords
        completion_kw = ['竣工', '投运', '完工', '通车', '交付', '启用', '投产', '落成', '移交', '通过验收', '并网', '全容量', '揭牌', '揭幕']
        if any(kw in line for kw in completion_kw):
            pairs.append({
                'report': report,
                'title': '',
                'detail': line,
                'report_date': report_date_map.get(report, '')
            })
        i += 1

print(f"Total pairs: {len(pairs)}")

# Now extract structured data from each pair
final_projects = []

for pair in pairs:
    title = pair['title']
    detail = pair['detail']
    combined = title + ' ' + detail
    report_date = pair['report_date']
    
    # Skip if it's about future events only
    future_kw = ['预计', '计划', '将', '拟']
    completion_kw = ['竣工', '投运', '完工', '通车', '交付', '启用', '投产', '落成', '移交', '通过验收', '并网', '全容量', '揭牌', '揭幕', '正式开通', '集中移交']
    
    has_completion = any(kw in combined for kw in completion_kw)
    if not has_completion:
        continue
    
    # Skip entries that are only about starting construction
    if ('开工' in combined or '启动' in combined or '签约' in combined or '中标' in combined) and not has_completion:
        continue
    
    # Skip "预计" future completions unless they also have actual completion
    if re.search(r'预计.*\d+年底.*完[工成]', combined) and not any(kw in combined for kw in ['竣工', '投运', '完工', '通车', '交付', '启用', '投产', '落成', '移交', '揭牌', '揭幕', '并网', '全容量']):
        continue
    
    # --- Extract Country ---
    country = ''
    # Country list
    country_list = [
        '特立尼达和多巴哥', '密克罗尼西亚', '刚果（布）', '刚果(布)',
        '沙特阿拉伯', '印度尼西亚', '哈萨克斯坦', '吉尔吉斯斯坦',
        '科特迪瓦', '塞内加尔', '乌兹别克斯坦', '北马其顿',
        '哥斯达黎加', '厄瓜多尔', '马达加斯加', '毛里塔尼亚',
        '克罗地亚', '塞尔维亚', '埃塞俄比亚', '坦桑尼亚',
        '孟加拉国', '尼日利亚', '阿尔及利亚', '几内亚',
        '伊拉克', '柬埔寨', '老挝', '缅甸',
        '秘鲁', '巴西', '智利', '阿根廷',
        '埃及', '乍得', '加纳', '肯尼亚',
        '卢旺达', '安哥拉', '赞比亚', '马拉维',
        '尼泊尔', '越南', '泰国', '马来西亚',
        '阿联酋', '迪拜', '沙特', '科威特',
        '土耳其', '亚美尼亚', '匈牙利', '波兰',
        '希腊', '俄罗斯', '巴林', '牙买加',
        '格林纳达', '瓦努阿图', '塞舌尔', '玻利维亚',
        '喀麦隆', '南苏丹', '莫桑比克', '津巴布韦',
        '纳米比亚', '斐济', '汤加', '文莱',
        '菲律宾', '巴基斯坦', '斯里兰卡', '马尔代夫',
        '蒙古', '新加坡', '东帝汶', '阿富汗',
    ]
    
    for c in country_list:
        if c in combined:
            country = c
            break
    
    # If no country found, try to extract from beginning of title
    if not country and title:
        # Try to get country from title start
        m = re.match(r'^([\u4e00-\u9fff]{2,6})', title)
        if m:
            potential = m.group(1)
            # Check it's likely a country
            if not any(kw in potential for kw in ['项目', '中国', '近日', '日前', '公路', '铁路', '水电', '光伏', '风电', '油田', '学校', '医院', '体育', '市政', '码头', '港口', '工厂', '办公', '桥梁', '隧道', '大坝', '水库', '营地', '社区', '酒店', '公寓', '保障', '住宅', '电网', '机场']):
                country = potential
    
    # --- Extract Project Name ---
    project_name = title.strip() if title else ''
    if not project_name:
        # Try to extract from detail
        m = re.search(r'承建[的]?([^，。]{5,50}?)项目', detail)
        if m:
            project_name = m.group(1).strip() + '项目'
        else:
            project_name = detail[:50].strip()
    
    # Clean project name - remove trailing completion status
    for suffix in ['进入竣工验收阶段', '竣工', '投运', '完工', '通车', '交付', '启用', '投产', '落成', '移交', '通过验收', '并网发电', '全容量并网', '揭牌启用', '集中移交', '正式开通', '举办揭牌启用仪式', '完成移交', '竣工移交', '正式竣工', '顺利完工移交', '正式投产', '正式投产使用', '提前投产', '全线通车', '正式通车', '竣工通车', '举行竣工仪式', '举行移交仪式', '举行通车仪式', '举行落成揭幕仪式', '举行揭牌启用仪式', '举行竣工典礼', '集中启用', '正式移交', '最终移交', '完成最终移交', '顺利通车', '双幅通车', '建成通车', '正式投产运营', '投产送电', '投产运营']:
        if project_name.endswith(suffix):
            project_name = project_name[:-len(suffix)].strip()
    
    # Remove country prefix from project name
    if country and project_name.startswith(country):
        project_name = project_name[len(country):].strip()
    
    # --- Extract Contractor ---
    contractor = ''
    # Pattern: 由XXX承建/总承包/参与
    m = re.search(r'由([^，。]{2,50}?)承建', detail)
    if m:
        contractor = m.group(1).strip()
    if not contractor:
        m = re.search(r'由([^，。]{2,50}?)总承包', detail)
        if m:
            contractor = m.group(1).strip()
    if not contractor:
        m = re.search(r'由([^，。]{2,50}?)参与', detail)
        if m:
            contractor = m.group(1).strip()
    if not contractor:
        m = re.search(r'由([^，。]{2,50}?)具体实施', detail)
        if m:
            contractor = m.group(1).strip()
    if not contractor:
        m = re.search(r'由([^，。]{2,50}?)下属', detail)
        if m:
            contractor = m.group(1).strip() + '下属'
            m2 = re.search(r'下属([^，。]{2,30}?)承建', detail)
            if m2:
                contractor = m.group(1).strip() + '下属' + m2.group(1).strip()
    if not contractor:
        m = re.search(r'由([^，。]{2,50}?)所属', detail)
        if m:
            contractor = m.group(1).strip() + '所属'
            m2 = re.search(r'所属([^，。]{2,30}?)承建', detail)
            if m2:
                contractor = m.group(1).strip() + '所属' + m2.group(1).strip()
    if not contractor:
        m = re.search(r'由([^，。]{2,50}?)控股', detail)
        if m:
            contractor = m.group(1).strip()
    if not contractor:
        m = re.search(r'由([^，。]{2,50}?)设计', detail)
        if m:
            contractor = m.group(1).strip()
    if not contractor:
        m = re.search(r'由([^，。]{2,50}?)投资', detail)
        if m:
            contractor = m.group(1).strip()
    if not contractor:
        m = re.search(r'由([^，。]{2,50}?)和', detail)
        if m:
            contractor = m.group(1).strip()
    if not contractor:
        m = re.search(r'由([^，。]{2,50}?)承建', detail)
        if m:
            contractor = m.group(1).strip()
    if not contractor:
        m = re.search(r'由([^，。]{2,50}?)开发', detail)
        if m:
            contractor = m.group(1).strip()
    if not contractor:
        m = re.search(r'由([^，。]{2,50}?)建设', detail)
        if m:
            contractor = m.group(1).strip()
    if not contractor:
        m = re.search(r'由([^，。]{2,50}?)联营体', detail)
        if m:
            contractor = m.group(1).strip() + '联营体'
    if not contractor:
        m = re.search(r'由([^，。]{2,50}?)联合体', detail)
        if m:
            contractor = m.group(1).strip() + '联合体'
    
    # Clean contractor
    if contractor:
        contractor = contractor.replace('下属', '').replace('所属', '').strip()
        # Remove trailing particles
        contractor = re.sub(r'[的、和与及]+$', '', contractor).strip()
    
    # --- Extract Start Date ---
    start_date = ''
    start_patterns = [
        r'于(\d{4}年\d+月)开工',
        r'于(\d{4}年\d+月)正式开工',
        r'于(\d{4}年\d+月)开工建设',
        r'(\d{4}年\d+月)开工',
        r'(\d{4}年\d+月)正式开工',
        r'(\d{4}年\d+月)开工建设',
        r'于(\d{4}年\d+月)动工',
        r'(\d{4}年\d+月)动工',
        r'于(\d{4}年\d+月)启动',
        r'(\d{4}年\d+月)启动',
        r'于(\d{4}年)开工',
        r'(\d{4}年)开工',
        r'建设期.*(\d{4}年\d+月)',
    ]
    for p in start_patterns:
        m = re.search(p, combined)
        if m:
            start_date = m.group(1)
            if re.match(r'^\d{4}年$', start_date):
                start_date = start_date.replace('年', '年1月')
            break
    
    # --- Extract Completion Date ---
    completion_date = ''
    # Look for specific dates
    date_patterns = [
        r'(\d{4}年\d+月\d+日)',
        r'(\d+月\d+日)',
    ]
    for p in date_patterns:
        m = re.search(p, detail)
        if m:
            completion_date = m.group(1)
            break
    
    # If no specific date, use report date
    if not completion_date:
        completion_date = report_date
    
    # Normalize completion date to 年月 format
    if completion_date:
        m = re.match(r'(\d{4})年(\d+)月(\d+)日', completion_date)
        if m:
            completion_date = f"{m.group(1)}年{int(m.group(2))}月"
        elif re.match(r'\d+月\d+日', completion_date):
            # Extract year from report_date
            m2 = re.match(r'(\d{4})年', report_date)
            year = m2.group(1) if m2 else '2025'
            m3 = re.match(r'(\d+)月', completion_date)
            month = m3.group(1) if m3 else ''
            if month:
                completion_date = f"{year}年{int(month)}月"
    
    if not start_date:
        start_date = '—'
    if not completion_date:
        completion_date = report_date if report_date else '—'
    if not country:
        country = '—'
    if not project_name:
        project_name = '—'
    if not contractor:
        contractor = '—'
    
    final_projects.append({
        'country': country,
        'project_name': project_name,
        'contractor': contractor,
        'start_date': start_date,
        'completion_date': completion_date,
    })

print(f"\nFinal projects: {len(final_projects)}")
print()
for i, p in enumerate(final_projects):
    print(f"[{i+1}] {p['country']} | {p['project_name'][:40]} | {p['contractor'][:30]} | {p['start_date']} | {p['completion_date']}")

# Save
with open('/workspace/final_projects.json', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump(final_projects, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

import json
import re

with open('/workspace/report_content.json', 'r') as f:
    raw_data = json.load(f)

# Build report date map
report_date_map = {}
for item in raw_data:
    report = item['report']
    m = re.search(r'[（(](\d{4})\.(\d+)\.(\d+)-(\d{4})\.(\d+)\.(\d+)[）)]', report)
    if m:
        end_year = m.group(4)
        end_month = int(m.group(5))
        start_year = m.group(1)
        start_month = int(m.group(2))
        # Use the end date as the report period
        report_date_map[report] = {
            'year': end_year,
            'month': end_month,
            'start_year': start_year,
            'start_month': start_month,
            'label': f"{end_year}年{end_month}月"
        }

# Build title-detail pairs
pairs = []
i = 0
while i < len(raw_data):
    item = raw_data[i]
    report = item['report']
    line = item['line']
    
    is_title = (len(line) < 80 and 
                not line.startswith('近日') and 
                not line.startswith('日前') and
                not re.match(r'^\d+月\d+日', line) and
                not re.match(r'^\d{4}年\d+月\d+日', line) and
                not line.startswith('该') and
                not line.startswith('项目') and
                not line.startswith('其') and
                not line.startswith('（') and
                not line.startswith('此') and
                not line.startswith('截至') and
                not line.startswith('梅罗') and
                not line.startswith('Per') and
                not line.startswith('新校园') and
                not line.startswith('1551') and
                not line.startswith('主要'))
    
    if is_title and i + 1 < len(raw_data) and raw_data[i+1]['report'] == report:
        pairs.append({'report': report, 'title': line, 'detail': raw_data[i+1]['line']})
        i += 2
    else:
        completion_kw = ['竣工', '投运', '完工', '通车', '交付', '启用', '投产', '落成', '移交', '通过验收', '并网', '全容量', '揭牌', '揭幕', '正式开通']
        if any(kw in line for kw in completion_kw):
            pairs.append({'report': report, 'title': '', 'detail': line})
        i += 1

# Country list (longest first for matching)
country_list = sorted([
    '特立尼达和多巴哥', '密克罗尼西亚联邦', '密克罗尼西亚',
    '刚果（布）', '刚果(布)', '刚果（金）', '刚果(金)',
    '沙特阿拉伯', '印度尼西亚', '哈萨克斯坦', '吉尔吉斯斯坦',
    '科特迪瓦', '塞内加尔', '乌兹别克斯坦', '北马其顿',
    '哥斯达黎加', '厄瓜多尔', '马达加斯加', '毛里塔尼亚',
    '克罗地亚', '塞尔维亚', '埃塞俄比亚', '坦桑尼亚',
    '孟加拉国', '尼日利亚', '阿尔及利亚', '几内亚',
    '伊拉克', '柬埔寨', '老挝', '缅甸',
    '秘鲁', '巴西', '智利', '阿根廷',
    '埃及', '乍得', '加纳', '肯尼亚',
    '卢旺达', '安哥拉', '赞比亚', '马拉维',
    '尼泊尔', '越南', '泰国', '马来西亚',
    '阿联酋', '迪拜', '沙特', '科威特',
    '土耳其', '亚美尼亚', '匈牙利', '波兰',
    '希腊', '俄罗斯', '巴林', '牙买加',
    '格林纳达', '瓦努阿图', '塞舌尔', '玻利维亚',
    '喀麦隆', '南苏丹', '莫桑比克', '津巴布韦',
    '纳米比亚', '斐济', '汤加', '文莱',
    '菲律宾', '巴基斯坦', '斯里兰卡', '马尔代夫',
    '蒙古', '新加坡', '东帝汶', '阿富汗',
    '莱索托', '阿曼', '摩洛哥',
], key=len, reverse=True)

def extract_country(text):
    for c in country_list:
        if c in text:
            return c
    return ''

def extract_contractor(text):
    patterns = [
        (r'由([^，。]{2,60}?)(?:下属|所属)([^，。]{2,40}?)承建', lambda m: m.group(1).strip() + '下属' + m.group(2).strip()),
        (r'由([^，。]{2,60}?)(?:下属|所属)([^，。]{2,40}?)总承包', lambda m: m.group(1).strip() + '下属' + m.group(2).strip()),
        (r'由([^，。]{2,60}?)和([^，。]{2,40}?)联营体', lambda m: m.group(1).strip() + '和' + m.group(2).strip() + '联营体'),
        (r'由([^，。]{2,60}?)、([^，。]{2,40}?)联营体', lambda m: m.group(1).strip() + '、' + m.group(2).strip() + '联营体'),
        (r'由([^，。]{2,60}?)和([^，。]{2,40}?)联合体', lambda m: m.group(1).strip() + '和' + m.group(2).strip() + '联合体'),
        (r'由([^，。]{2,60}?)、([^，。]{2,40}?)联合体', lambda m: m.group(1).strip() + '、' + m.group(2).strip() + '联合体'),
        (r'由([^，。]{2,60}?)承建', lambda m: m.group(1).strip()),
        (r'由([^，。]{2,60}?)总承包', lambda m: m.group(1).strip()),
        (r'由([^，。]{2,60}?)参与', lambda m: m.group(1).strip()),
        (r'由([^，。]{2,60}?)具体实施', lambda m: m.group(1).strip()),
        (r'由([^，。]{2,60}?)控股', lambda m: m.group(1).strip()),
        (r'由([^，。]{2,60}?)设计', lambda m: m.group(1).strip()),
        (r'由([^，。]{2,60}?)投资', lambda m: m.group(1).strip()),
        (r'由([^，。]{2,60}?)参建', lambda m: m.group(1).strip()),
        (r'由([^，。]{2,60}?)开发', lambda m: m.group(1).strip()),
    ]
    for pattern, extractor in patterns:
        m = re.search(pattern, text)
        if m:
            contractor = extractor(m)
            contractor = re.sub(r'[的、和与及]+$', '', contractor).strip()
            if len(contractor) > 3:
                return contractor
    return ''

def extract_start_date(text):
    patterns = [
        r'于(\d{4}年\d+月)开工',
        r'于(\d{4}年\d+月)正式开工',
        r'于(\d{4}年\d+月)开工建设',
        r'(\d{4}年\d+月)开工',
        r'(\d{4}年\d+月)正式开工',
        r'(\d{4}年\d+月)开工建设',
        r'于(\d{4}年\d+月)动工',
        r'(\d{4}年\d+月)启动',
        r'于(\d{4}年)开工',
        r'(\d{4}年)开工',
    ]
    for p in patterns:
        m = re.search(p, text)
        if m:
            d = m.group(1)
            if re.match(r'^\d{4}年$', d):
                d = d.replace('年', '年1月')
            return d
    return ''

def extract_completion_date(detail, report_info):
    # Look for specific date
    m = re.search(r'(\d{4}年\d+月\d+日)', detail)
    if m:
        d = m.group(1)
        m2 = re.match(r'(\d{4})年(\d+)月', d)
        if m2:
            return f"{m2.group(1)}年{int(m2.group(2))}月"
    
    m = re.search(r'(\d+月\d+日)', detail)
    if m and report_info:
        month = re.match(r'(\d+)月', m.group(1))
        if month:
            return f"{report_info['year']}年{int(month.group(1))}月"
    
    if report_info:
        return report_info['label']
    return ''

# Now process all pairs
final_projects = []

for pair in pairs:
    title = pair['title']
    detail = pair['detail']
    combined = title + ' ' + detail
    report = pair['report']
    report_info = report_date_map.get(report, None)
    
    # Check if this is a completion event
    completion_kw = ['竣工', '投运', '完工', '通车', '交付', '启用', '投产', '落成', '移交', '通过验收', '并网', '全容量', '揭牌', '揭幕', '正式开通', '集中移交', '完成移交']
    non_completion_kw = ['中标', '签约', '封顶', '开工', '启动建设', '奠基', '动工', '开焊', '吊装', '贯通']
    
    has_completion = any(kw in combined for kw in completion_kw)
    has_non_completion = any(kw in title for kw in non_completion_kw) if title else False
    
    # Skip entries that are primarily about non-completion events
    if has_non_completion and not has_completion:
        continue
    if not has_completion:
        continue
    
    # Skip future-only events
    if re.search(r'预计.*\d+.*完[工成]', combined) and not any(kw in combined for kw in ['竣工', '投运', '完工', '通车', '交付', '启用', '投产', '落成', '移交', '揭牌', '揭幕', '并网', '全容量']):
        continue
    
    # Filter to Jan-May 2025
    if report_info:
        end_month = report_info['month']
        end_year = int(report_info['year'])
        # Include reports that cover Jan-May 2025
        if end_year > 2025 or (end_year == 2025 and end_month > 6):
            continue
        if end_year < 2025:
            continue
    
    # Extract fields
    country = extract_country(combined)
    contractor = extract_contractor(detail)
    start_date = extract_start_date(combined)
    completion_date = extract_completion_date(detail, report_info)
    
    # Project name
    project_name = title.strip() if title else ''
    if not project_name:
        m = re.search(r'承建[的]?([^，。]{5,50}?)项目', detail)
        if m:
            project_name = m.group(1).strip() + '项目'
    
    # Clean project name
    if project_name:
        # Remove country prefix
        if country and project_name.startswith(country):
            project_name = project_name[len(country):].strip()
        
        # Remove trailing status words
        suffixes = ['进入竣工验收阶段', '举行揭牌启用仪式', '举办揭牌启用仪式',
                    '竣工并移交使用', '全容量并网发电', '全容量商业运行',
                    '首批组件并网发电', '正式投产使用', '提前投产',
                    '举行移交仪式', '举行通车仪式', '举行落成揭幕仪式',
                    '举行竣工典礼', '举行竣工仪式', '集中启用',
                    '正式移交', '最终移交', '完成最终移交',
                    '顺利完工移交', '顺利通车', '双幅通车',
                    '建成通车', '正式投产运营', '投产送电',
                    '正式投产', '全线通车', '正式通车',
                    '竣工通车', '竣工移交', '正式竣工',
                    '完工移交', '通过竣工验收', '通过完工验收',
                    '正式启用', '集中移交', '完成移交',
                    '取得竣工证书', '竣工交付', '正式交付',
                    '完成交付', '顺利交付', '正式开通运营',
                    '移交并开通运营', '通车试运营', '正式运营',
                    '顺利运营', '正式落成', '落成揭幕',
                    '投产运营', '投产发电', '并网发电',
                    '送电一次成功', '正式打火开焊',
                    '竣工', '投运', '完工', '通车', '交付',
                    '启用', '投产', '落成', '移交', '并网',
                    '全容量', '揭牌', '揭幕', '开通']
        for s in suffixes:
            if project_name.endswith(s):
                project_name = project_name[:-len(s)].strip()
                break
    
    # Skip entries with no meaningful project name
    if not project_name or len(project_name) < 3:
        # Try harder to extract from detail
        m = re.search(r'(?:承建|建设|完成|参与)[的]?([^，。]{3,40}?)项目', detail)
        if m:
            project_name = m.group(1).strip() + '项目'
        else:
            # Skip entries that are clearly non-project (中标/签约)
            if '中标' in detail or '签约' in detail:
                continue
            project_name = detail[:40].strip()
            if len(project_name) < 5:
                continue
    
    # Skip entries that are clearly not completed projects
    if any(kw in detail[:30] for kw in ['中标', '签约']) and not has_completion:
        continue
    
    # Clean contractor name - remove duplicate prefixes
    if contractor:
        # Fix patterns like "中国电建中国电建市政"
        contractor = re.sub(r'(中国电建)中国电建', r'\1', contractor)
        contractor = re.sub(r'(中国交建)中国交建', r'\1', contractor)
        contractor = re.sub(r'(中国铁建)中国铁建', r'\1', contractor)
        contractor = re.sub(r'(中国能建)中国能建', r'\1', contractor)
        contractor = re.sub(r'(中国建筑)中国建筑', r'\1', contractor)
    
    if not country:
        country = '—'
    if not project_name:
        project_name = '—'
    if not contractor:
        contractor = '—'
    if not start_date:
        start_date = '—'
    if not completion_date:
        completion_date = '—'
    
    final_projects.append({
        'country': country,
        'project_name': project_name,
        'contractor': contractor,
        'start_date': start_date,
        'completion_date': completion_date,
    })

print(f"Total final projects: {len(final_projects)}")
print()
for i, p in enumerate(final_projects):
    print(f"[{i+1}] {p['country']} | {p['project_name'][:45]} | {p['contractor'][:35]} | {p['start_date']} | {p['completion_date']}")

with open('/workspace/final_projects.json', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump(final_projects, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)

    # Final cleanup of name

    if not name or name == '—':

    cleaned.append({

        'start_date': start if start else '—',

    })

print(f"Cleaned projects: {len(cleaned)}")
print()

# Generate Markdown table

table = '\n'.join(lines)

# Write to output.md
